claim_ceiling: A governance audit. It licenses no claim of any kind.
directionality_precedent: changing the IMPLEMENTATION to match the REGISTERED TEXT is a bug fix; changing the REGISTERED TEXT to match the DATA is p-hacking. The difference is the direction, not the outcome

entries.implementation: prove_object.main, which reads it from the pushed registration
entries.registered_text: the accuracy floor is unchanged at 0.80, the same floor the predecessor failed
entries.what_the_code_actually_does: the tool reads condition_3.requirement_4_accuracy_floor.now and applies it; it hard-codes no floor
entries.why_this_entry_exists: a rebuild is exactly where a threshold quietly moves, and 0.7562 against 0.80 was the most tempting position in which to move one

entries.implementation: prove_object.main, required_drop parsed from the registration
entries.registered_text: the requirement 3 drop floor rises from > 0.50 to >= 0.640625
entries.what_the_code_actually_does: the floor is the value P-0c measured, and the comparison is >= rather than the strict > the predecessor used

entries.registered_text: the ablation ceiling is unchanged
entries.what_the_code_actually_does: read from the registration and applied unchanged

entries.registered_text: one rebuild only; if this object also misses the floor there is no third
entries.what_the_code_actually_does: the registration records the permission and states the consequence of a second failure in advance

entries.registered_text: P-0c's OBJECT_NOT_ESTABLISHED is not withdrawn, rewritten or reinterpreted
entries.what_the_code_actually_does: the closure records all three as false and the determination unchanged

entries.registered_text: no patching data may exist or be consulted during the rebuild
entries.what_the_code_actually_does: the registration records both counters as zero at the time the object was built

entries.registered_text: the number of registration lines drops from 6 to 4
entries.what_the_code_actually_does: the live constant is what the build uses for both the prompt and the position cycle

entries.registered_text: positions are balanced by cycling through the ordered position pairs
entries.what_the_code_actually_does: the cycle is every ordered pair of distinct positions, so coverage is even by construction and the donor and recipient roles are balanced across positions too

entries.registered_text: requirement 6 is applied to the name pool, measured IN CONTEXT
entries.what_the_code_actually_does: the pool is grouped by the token length of ' {name}', the form the name takes in the question line, so every pair satisfies requirement 6 by construction with no silent rejection

entries.registered_text: the build seed is unchanged from P-0c
entries.what_the_code_actually_does: the same seed drives the rebuild, so the change in the object comes from the registered parameter change and not from a reroll

entries.implementation: od022_sweep.CANDIDATES, checked against the shortlist at run time
entries.registered_text: the shortlist is closed; no member may be added or removed
entries.what_the_code_actually_does: the tool REFUSES TO RUN if its implemented candidate names differ from the shortlist's, so a silently added candidate cannot be swept

entries.implementation: od022_sweep, its imports and its inputs
entries.registered_text: the sweep is computed from clean runs alone
entries.what_the_code_actually_does: the module imports argparse, json, math, random, sys and pathlib; it opens only the shortlist and touches no measurement

entries.registered_text: destroyed is not a single thing; a candidate that survives only one construction has not survived
entries.what_the_code_actually_does: each candidate is swept under both flatten and resample, and survival requires passing both

entries.implementation: guard_p0.imports_jlens over every tool in this namespace
entries.registered_text: no P-0c-2 tool imports the library EQ2 was testing
entries.what_the_code_actually_does: the check matches an import statement rather than the bare word

entries.implementation: guard_p0.scan_tools, which applies the registered self-exclusion
entries.registered_text: no P-0c-2 tool references T
entries.what_the_code_actually_does: guard_p0.py is the only file excluded, because it cannot scan for markers without containing them

entries.implementation: prove_object.main, which looks the verbatim text up by name
entries.registered_text: the determination must be one of the wordings fixed before any forward pass
entries.what_the_code_actually_does: the determination string selects a registered wording and cannot produce one that was not registered

entries.registered_text: the drop must be at least the registered floor
entries.what_the_code_actually_does: the comparison is >=, against a floor read from the registration

entries.registered_text: the object proof runs on clean runs only
entries.what_the_code_actually_does: the tool performs forward passes and reads last-position logits

entries.registered_text: accuracy by position must be reported over all units AND over the correct-both subset
entries.what_the_code_actually_does: the report carries the position counts before and after filtering and the share shift between them

entries.registered_text: the correct-both floor is 60
entries.what_the_code_actually_does: the count is compared against the registered floor

entries.registered_text: the shortlist may not be added to, removed from, or repaired
entries.what_the_code_actually_does: the committed sweep records both counters

entries.registered_text: every candidate's numbers are reported, not only the winner's
entries.what_the_code_actually_does: results carries an entry for every candidate on the shortlist

entries.implementation: verify_baseline, as run on the REBUILT object
entries.registered_text: the no-op families must be exactly 0.000e+00, not merely within tolerance
entries.what_the_code_actually_does: the committed report records the worst normalised mean over all three families

method: each module is imported and its live values are compared against the committed registrations
what_this_phase_adds: a rebuild is exactly where a threshold quietly moves, so every threshold is audited for having held or moved only in the tightening direction, and the closed shortlist is audited for having been neither added to nor repaired
